changes.title: Idle near stone
items: Hostile creatures now hang around their area's runestone instead of anywhere in the area, so heading for the stone means meeting them

changes.title: No loss penalty
items: Losing a soundsystem no longer brings the next wave sooner
Each knockdown now speeds the beat up by 5 BPM, not 1, and the waves come that much sooner

changes.title: Ed knobs
items: Wild animals size you up for 4 seconds, not 6, before they attack
The ley line's glowing front now runs 2.5 times as fast as the pulse
